## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: (1) very weak sector breadth (only Healthcare and Technology positive) and (2) major divergence across large caps with multiple names showing 1W vs 1M mismatch (MSFT, TSLA, LLY); Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 from Tech/Healthcare/Energy).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Technology next: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing pockets of strength: MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.86% | 1M: +19.36%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +12.73%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication lagging: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -15.94%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND. Utilities underperforming: CEG (1W: -10.55% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND alongside sector weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span Tech/Healthcare/Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communications and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96%), AMD (1W: +8.46%), MPC (1W: +7.31%), TMO (1W: +6.91%), ISRG (1W: +6.55%) — note ISRG is RECOVERY (1M down, 1W up) so this is tactical accumulation rather than confirmed long-term reversal; LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY is another divergence to watch.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but selective strength: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND — Tech is one of only two sectors positive this week, but leadership is uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are soft: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND; V (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.75%) CORRECTION shows short-term weakness — sector breadth negative and a source of market risk.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing relative resilience: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY; several names (LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY) are showing short-term rebounds while 1M performance lags.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to above-trend cyclicals and healthcare winners (AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad Communication and weak Financials (NFLX, BAC, GS) until breadth improves; Style: Mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND on upgrades/earnings, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND for momentum, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY on EU approval. BEARISH: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND on bond-loss headlines, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND despite buyback story.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (sector positive this week) and selective Energy (MPC, VLO, PSX ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Communication and Financials remain at risk given steep 1W losses and negative sentiment.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch AMD for continuation of its 1M uptrend and hold above the recent breakout area as a positive trigger (ABOVE TREND). Monitor BAC for further downside continuation below recent support as escalation of Financials risk (BELOW TREND). Track ISRG holding the 1W gains as confirmation of RECOVERY after EU approval; failure to hold suggests a short-lived rebound.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+80): EU nod for da Vinci SP — ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY, short-term price action confirms the headline. MPC (+60): upgrade/beat — MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, price confirms sentiment. PSX (+55): UBS bullish — PSX (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +12.73%) ABOVE TREND, confirmation on momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BAC (-85): bond-loss headlines — BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. CVS (-80): fraud verdict — CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, confirmed. TSLA (-55): regulatory scrutiny on Cybercab — TSLA (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +3.75%) CORRECTION, news is a divergence versus 1M strength and warrants monitoring.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: extremely weak breadth (2/11) plus major divergences among large caps and negative sentiment in Financials (BAC) and Communications (NFLX) that could keep the market range-bound.
